US Envoy States No Forced Exodus Planned for Palestinians from Gaza

The U.S. ambassador to Israel has stated that there is no plan to force Palestinians out of Gaza. This statement comes amid proposals from some Israeli ministers advocating for the migration of Palestinians from Gaza. The ambassador explicitly ruled out any forced exodus, asserting that such a plan does not exist.
